script:
set -eu
mkdir -p /workspace/demo
cd /workspace/demo
printf '#include <stdio.h>\nint main(void){puts("hello");return 0;}\n' > main.c
clang main.c -o hello.wasm
./hello.wasm | grep hello > result.txt
cat result.txt
